notes.title: Production Update 2
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Good news! Production of all the levels has been completed. All levels including their respective [/p][p]puzzles are up and running from start to finish. The game is now in its final stages of development[/p][p]which include final polishing, adding more assets to fill out the environment, lighting adjustments [/p][p]and fine tuning AI and story-beat elements. It has been a long journey but the finish line is on the[/p][p]horizon! Stay tuned for further updates as [b]Project Fiend[/b] get closer to release![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/bf6f31d3101b73a5953337a49398132c66392919.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/d5d0d67de75f7d23a5133565485bce918ec35164.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/daa9215c232ff978617d490fbf29e27f42095925.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/63879361d94d3be9975af63b95c00f6dffa29b8f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/ad655c8762e3f61818ccfb6e856d2ba793ca77ea.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/e020448337418411a00684ebd2ccde7e6ce06a3c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/de04d8caf98776c3914bcec0e5d98729dd6772fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/9991902b5f0624320bad4ca7591dec6673896310.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: PRODUCTION UPDATE
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p]The first four levels of the game have been completed (minus the final polish) and [/p][p]fully playable! New diverse locations to explore and more exciting puzzles to solve![/p][p]Although there are more levels in development, production is going smoother could[/p][p]have been anticipated and I look forward to bringing [b]Project Fiend[/b] closer to completion.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience![/p][p][/p][p]Here are some screenshots of the levels so far:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/db76309b44f798faad0a9870777abfa52d14b4c1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/70e09e3855d972247b81404d19f5aba41dff2b7c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469935/c1508f6d25fcef93d1003c3328ee7396aadc5042.png"][/img] [/p]
